name: Wynonna Earp
description: Wyatt Earp's great granddaughter Wynonna battles demons and other creatures with her unique abilities and a posse of dysfunctional allies - the only thing that can bring the paranormal to justice.

videos.title: Purgatory
videos.overview: Wyatt Earp's great granddaughter celebrates her 27th birthday by reluctantly returning to her hometown to take on her family's legendary curse.

videos.title: Keep the Home Fires Burning
videos.overview: Wynonna attracts some unwanted attention after returning to Purgatory. At the same time, she struggles to keep her impetuous nature in check while trying to conform to the rules imposed by the Black Badge Division. In other happenings, drifter Henry makes a deal he may not be able to honor.

videos.title: Leavin' on Your Mind
videos.overview: Wynonna investigates when a posse of Revenants go on a killing spree, which she concludes has a darker and more sinister point behind it. Meanwhile, Waverly challenges Henry's motives and sets out to unearth more of his past.

videos.title: The Blade
videos.overview: Wynonna and Dolls try to stop an invisible assailant killing Purgatory residents.

videos.title: Diggin' Up Bones
videos.overview: Wynonna and Dolls make a daring raid on the trailer park run by the lead Revenant. Henry comes face to face with an old nemesis.

videos.title: Constant Cravings
videos.overview: Wynonna hunts down one of the Revenants responsible for the attack on the Homestead fifteen years earlier. Waverly unravels a mystery left behind by her Uncle Curtis.

videos.title: Walking After Midnight
videos.overview: Waverly's engagement party guests are put in danger by Henry's quest for revenge. Wynonna investigates a killer targeting young women.

videos.title: Two-Faced Jack
videos.overview: Henry and Deputy Marshall Dolls infiltrate a Revenant hive. Wynonna tries to avoid being a serial killer's next victim.

videos.title: Bury Me with My Guns On
videos.overview: Wynonna undergoes a psychiatric fitness test that she initially fails but Dolls ends up having her back after she sleeps with Doc.

videos.title: She Wouldn't Be Gone
videos.overview: Wynonna and Dolls investigate the snowy Barrens and the rumors of a bloodthirsty beast. Henry confronts his future with Waverly's help.

videos.title: Landslide
videos.overview: Wynonna puts the discovery in the Barrens behind her after a gambler is torn apart. Henry meets a mysterious stranger.

videos.title: House of Memories
videos.overview: An admirer with a gruesome vendetta threatens the town. Wynonna tries to outwit Bobo Del Rey and protect Dolls.

videos.title: I Walk the Line
videos.overview: A treachery is revealed. Wynonna prepares for her final showdown with Bobo.

videos.title: Steel Bars and Stone Walls
videos.overview: Wynonna tries to rescue a seemingly mutated Dolls. There may be more to Waverly than meets the eye.

videos.title: Shed Your Skin
videos.overview: While Waverly's change accelerates and Doc makes a dangerous deal, Wynonna must fight spider creatures. Yep.

videos.title: Gonna Getcha Good
videos.overview: Doc tries to help a friend, while Wynonna must deal with an angry Marzanoik - that's like a genie but way more evil - with payback on his mind. It's Wynonna to the rescue when this demonic force threatens some high school friends. But there's a much bigger threat looming.

videos.title: She Ain't Right
videos.overview: The team must recover a very powerful briefcase before it falls into the wrong hands. Don't expect everything to go smoothly - it's Earp vs. Earp as Wynonna fights for her sister Waverly's soul.

videos.title: Let's Pretend We're Strangers
videos.overview: A furious thunder-snowstorm makes landfall while Wynonna and Waverly are forced to confront their demons - and each other.

videos.title: Whiskey Lullaby
videos.overview: Wynonna races against the clock to save Purgatory before the whole town takes a permanent dirt nap.

videos.title: Everybody Knows
videos.overview: Doc and Wynonna's indiscretions haunt the team and the ties that bind them. Wynonna's past mistakes hold present consequences, while Purgatory has a new most wanted: Doc Holliday. Wynonna and Nicole hit the road for answers.

videos.title: No Future in the Past
videos.overview: Wynonna has an opportunity to discover the origins of the Earp curse while her team works to save the future.

videos.title: Forever Mine Nevermind
videos.overview: Wynonna asks Doc to make an impossible choice. Waverly makes a new friend - and is terrorized by an old one.

videos.title: I See a Darkness
videos.overview: The team may not be able to save one of their own after a deadly run-in with the widows.

videos.title: Gone as a Girl Can Get
videos.overview: Allies become enemies when a vengeful wish goes awry.

videos.title: I Hope You Dance
videos.overview: Wynonna is running out of time, and is desperate to defeat the widows before her fate is sealed.

videos.title: Blood Red and Going Down
videos.overview: When a mysterious bus full of sexy strangers rolls into town, Wynonna must figure out why they are in Purgatory before the entire town falls under their spell.

videos.title: When You Call My Name
videos.overview: The demon who cursed the Earp heir reveals himself in a shocking turn of events that will leave the team forever changed.

videos.title: Colder Weather
videos.overview: The team must come to terms with the consequences of their actions. Meanwhile, someone claiming to be from Black Badge Division arrives in Purgatory.

videos.title: No Cure for Crazy
videos.overview: The forest reveals its secrets - and a clue to Nicole's past. Meanwhile, Wynonna pays an unexpected visit to her mother.

videos.title: Jolene
videos.overview: A demon causes havoc in town as Wynonna, Waverly and Jolene must decide who they can trust.

videos.title: If We Make It Through December
videos.overview: Eggnog for everyone! It's holiday season in Purgatory! Wynonna teams up with a new ally to search for a missing kid on Christmas Day. Meanwhile, Waverly learns more about her father.

videos.title: I Fall to Pieces
videos.overview: Lady Luck seems to have abandoned Wynonna and Nicole when an errand for Nedley goes terribly wrong. Mama discovers Doc's secret.

videos.title: Waiting Forever for You
videos.overview: It's date night in Purgatory, which means dressing up, drinking, and fighting demons as a formidable, former foe stalks the gang.

videos.title: Undo It
videos.overview: History keeps repeating itself when Wynonna has to make an impossible choice. Waverly and Nicole visit a jeweller and a familiar face returns to Purgatory.

videos.title: The Other Woman
videos.overview: A mysterious woman who knows a little too much about the Earps arrives on the Homestead with a special mission for Wynonna and Waverly. The rest of the team must wrangle a deadly fire witch.

videos.title: Daddy Lessons
videos.overview: Wynonna has a run in with Revenants that leads her to an unexpected revelation about the curse. Waverly meets an important figure from her past, and Nicole tries to evacuate Purgatory - before it's too late.

videos.title: War Paint
videos.overview: The Pledge Moon looms over Purgatory as Wynonna and Waverly must find a way to end the family curse before their demonic foe puts an end to the Earp line - and humanity - once and for all.

videos.title: On the Road Again
videos.overview: Wynonna Earp races to find a way into the Garden before her sister is trapped forever.

videos.title: Friends in Low Places
videos.overview: Wynonna works with a new ally to rescue her family, but reunions come at a price.

videos.title: Look at Them Beans
videos.overview: Wynonna finds herself on the wrong side of the law and Doc partners with a new demon.

videos.title: Afraid
videos.overview: Wynonna faces down an ancient enemy as Waverly and Nicole search for help.

videos.title: Holy War (1)
videos.overview: Trouble at the Homestead leads to payback time for a deadly deal.

videos.title: Holy War (2)
videos.overview: The gang races to save one of their own, but are hindered by unseen forces.

videos.title: Love's All Over
videos.overview: Love is in the air as Waverly and Nicole celebrate their engagement with an enchanted evening.

videos.title: Hell Raisin' Good Time
videos.overview: Wynonna and Waverly have a Halloween they'll never forget as Rotten Jack terrorizes Purgatory.

videos.title: Crazy
videos.overview: It's Trivia Night in Purgatory and that can only mean murder, mayhem and brain sandwiches.

videos.title: Life Turned Her That Way
videos.overview: A deadly foe re-emerges in the Ghost River Triangle, intent on finishing what they started.

videos.title: Better Dig Two
videos.overview: Wynonna and Waverly take two very different and dangerous paths in an effort to save Purgatory.

videos.title: Old Souls
videos.overview: Big feelings and bigger decisions are revealed when a new witch makes herself known in Purgatory.
